blocks.text: API Key Management is a repository for an organization to store created API keys for admin roles. An API key consists of an API Key ID and Secret. These two items are required for access to Digital Experience (ZDX) APIs.
API Key Management provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: Provide a repository of generated, authorized API keys for programmatic access to ZDX APIs.
Maintain the configuration of API keys by creating, viewing, editing, or deleting the API keys as required.
Identify the life cycle of an API key to maintain security.

blocks.text: If you must obtain API keys or secrets to access Zscaler OneAPI endpoints, see About API Clients.

blocks.heading: About the API Key Management Page

blocks.text: On the API Key Management page (Administration > API > Legacy API > Digital Experience API Keys), you can do the following:

blocks.item: View a list of created API keys. For each API key, you can view:
Name: The name of the API key.
Key ID: The ID of the API key.
Role: The role the API key is assigned to.
Created By: The username that created the API key.
Last Updated On: The timestamp of when the API key was last updated.
Actions: The View, Edit, and Delete actions that can be performed on the API key.
Configure the number of API keys to display per page or navigate the API keys pages.
